name: nordstern
description: A local, offline, no-build dashboard for personal net worth, spending and FIRE progress. Reads your spreadsheet in the browser and sends nothing anywhere.

scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.test: node tests/behaviour.mjs && node tests/geometry.mjs && node tests/formats.mjs && node tests/example.mjs && node tests/build.mjs && node tests/hook.mjs

author: Christian J. Heinze
